title: Platelet count–volume coupling adds no established HbA1c prediction benefit beyond flexible routine measures: an exploratory recruitment-wave transport test
abstract: Platelet count–volume coupling did not establish incremental glucose-conditional HbA1c prediction in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transport (5,170 source;4,669 target adults): weighted MSE added-minus-baseline 0.00000615 HbA1c percentage-points², joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval [-0.00062396,0.00158775].
